description: Replaces the regular weekly hours of the workers named in staffNames with exactly the windows in entries (day_of_week 0 = Sunday to 6 = Saturday, HH:MM times; several windows a day allowed; a named worker with no entries has no regular hours). Workers not in staffNames are untouched. Omit entries to leave hours alone and only save profiles (the worker's details: email, phone, allergies, and venmo / zelle, which change only for a seat allowed to change payment handles). For one date only, use set_staff_availability. If the new hours no longer cover a worker's upcoming Sergio visits, those visits are released and a task is filed for a person. Nothing is sent. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: set_staff_weekly_hours
title: Save a field worker's weekly hours or details
